title: ASH: Asymmetric Scalar Hashing With Learned Dimensionality Reduction for High-Fidelity Vector Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2606.07870v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For a long time, additive quantizers, such as product quantization, have been considered the gold standard in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Recently, scalar quantization has re-emerged from the depths of history with a new wave of data-agnostic techniques. Inscribed in this general framework, we turn our attention to data-driven methods, showing that new highs in recall and speed can be achieved by reducing the number of dimensions while increasing the bitrate per dimension. Critically, this dimensionality reduction needs to be learned from data to be successful. We present ASH (Asymmetric Scalar Hashing), a data-driven encoder-decoder framework that applies dimensionality reduction to database vectors via a learned orthonormal projection, followed by scalar quantization, while keeping queries in their original form. translated_title: ASH：基于学习降维的非对称标量哈希用于高保真向量量化
translated_abstract: 长期以来，加性量化器（如乘积量化）一直被视为准确性和效率方面的黄金标准。最近，标量量化凭借新一波数据无关技术从历史深处重新崛起。在这一总体框架下，我们转向数据驱动方法，表明通过减少维度同时提高每维比特率，可以在召回率和速度上达到新的高度。关键在于，这种降维必须从数据中学习才能成功。我们提出了ASH（非对称标量哈希），一种数据驱动的编码器-解码器框架，通过学习的正交投影对数据库向量进行降维，随后进行标量量化，同时保持查询向量原始形式。这种非对称设计在相同压缩率下，比最佳的加性和标量量化器实现了更高的准确性。
tldr: ASH通过数据驱动的正交投影降维和标量量化，结合非对称查询处理，在相同压缩率下实现了比现有量化方法更高的准确性和速度。
en_tdlr: ASH achieves higher accuracy and speed than existing quantization methods at iso-compression by applying data-driven orthonormal projection for dimensionality reduction and scalar quantization with asymmetric query processing.
